blocks.text: INDIAN WELLS–Women’s Tennis Association chief Valerie Camillo apologized on Friday after a courtside microphone captured US star Jessica Pegula making disparaging comments about rival Mirra Andreeva. Pegula was plunged into controversy after her conversation with coach Mark Knowles on a practice court at Indian Wells in California was broadcast on a WTA YouTube livestream of the session. In the exchange, Pegula can be heard describing 19-year-old Russian Andreeva as a “diva”.
